# New Enemy Mutation: Reflective / Reflective in daily operations and mutant events

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_105_nukaknights-post-mutation-reflective.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

On the current PTS (since December 2022) we see a new mutation: **Reflective / Reflective**.

The mutation can spawn in Daily Operations and also in the new Mutant public events.

## How does the Reflective mutation work?

The enemies here change their state to reflective and normal at intervals of **5 seconds**. As soon as they are **Reflective**, there is a **bright glowing effect** on them. Once they are reflective, that means they **reflect some of the damage dealt back to you**. In plain language: if you damage enemies in this state, you yourself will die.

But there is an exception: the **mutation ignores explosions**. This means you can inflict damage with explosive weapons or grenades without taking damage yourself. Now you might think this would be a bug. No, that's intentional. Confirmed by Bethesda Community Manager:
![](/uploads/mutations-reflective-explosive-devann.png)

Source: Bethesda Discord

Other ways to deal damage to reflective enemies are: **Throwing weapons** & the perk "**Down through the middle**" under Strength ("Deal damage to enemies and stagger them by sprinting against them with power armor").

This is what it looks like when the opponents change states:

## What is the best way to play the Reflective mutation?

Now, as a result of the events, there are various scenarios that can occur. And even with double mutations, one or two difficult challenges can of course await us. But even simple mutations can become a challenge.

Examples with challenges:

- **Daily Operations with Link Device (Increased Perception) and Reflective as Command Build:**
Here you have to look very carefully before you shoot. Normally, as a command build, you play sneakily without exploiting. That's not easy in this case. Sneaking is not possible with a connecting device, so the bonus is lost. Without Explo means that you only deal damage with direct hits, which you can only do when the enemies are not reflecting. Many will probably die here often in the beginning. Solution: Either only shoot at opponents who are currently not reflecting, or e.g. Play a thirst quencher with Quantum Mod.
- **Daily Operations with Decryption (Armor Penetration) and Reflective as a Heavy Gunner Build in PA:**
Here you have the opposite problem. Of course, the opponents spot you immediately. But you can't shoot directly at the enemy when it reflects, otherwise you'll be dead. If you don't close, the armor penetration can quickly finish you off. Solution: Play with an explosive weapon (e.g. automatic grenade launcher) or shoot the ground in front of the opponent with Vampire Explo MG.

In the end, everyone will find their own way to deal with the mutation. If you know how it works, there are enough options.

### Videos

The best way to deal with the Reflective Mutation is the **Automatic Grenade Launcher (AGL)** e.g. the **Nuka thrower** from the season. Double shot is the best choice for the AGL here. Since the mutation doesn't reflect the damage from explosions, you're significantly better off with it than with any other firearm. Another advantage over the thirst quencher is that you get concept-related ammunition back.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-pts-dailyops-reflective-aliens-uplink-youtube.jpg)

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-dailyops-reflective-encryption-agl-youtube.jpg)
